use_when: 企业设备管理
MDM
设备管控

开发MDM/EMM客户端，在COPE或BYOD设备上通过EnterpriseAdminExtensionAbility与已激活的Admin下发设备级密码、应用安装/禁用、Wi‑Fi、USB、相机等管控策略 / Developing an MDM/EMM client that uses EnterpriseAdminExtensionAbility and an activated Admin to enforce device-level password, app install/disable, Wi‑Fi, USB, and camera control policies on COPE or BYOD devices
应用管理
如何开发企业MDM应用，实现设备集中管理和远程配置？
如何创建EnterpriseAdminExtensionAbility组件作为MDM应用的必备组件？
如何实现企业设备的应用管理（安装/卸载/禁用指定应用）？
如何设置设备安全策略，如密码策略、设备加密等？
如何远程控制设备，如锁屏、恢复出厂设置？
如何管理设备硬件外设，如禁用USB、限制相机使用？
如何配置设备的蓝牙、WiFi、屏幕亮度等系统设置？
如何实现COPE（企业派发设备）和BYOD（自带设备办公）场景下的设备管理？
如何处理多家EMM厂商共同管理设备时的角色激活与策略冲突？
如何申请MDM应用资质和声明所需权限？
当您的应用需要为企业或政府机构提供设备集中管理能力时，应使用MDM Kit
典型场景包括：企业统一采购并分发设备给员工使用（COPE），需要远程配置设备策略、管控应用安装、限制设备功能、设置安全策略等；以及允许员工携带个人设备接入办公环境（BYOD），需要在员工设备上部署企业安全策略、隔离企业数据等
当您需要开发MDM管理类应用（如EMM客户端）、实现设备安全合规检查、批量配置企业设备、或者需要对设备进行远程锁定/擦除等安全操作时，也应当使用MDM Kit
创建企业管理后台批量下发设备限制策略 / Build an enterprise admin console to push device restriction policies in bulk
实现 EnterpriseAdminExtensionAbility 作为设备管理员入口 / Implement EnterpriseAdminExtensionAbility as the device admin entry point
远程锁定企业终端并支持一键清除数据 / Remotely lock corporate devices and support one-tap data wipe
批量安装卸载工作应用并禁止员工自行移除 / Install or uninstall work apps in bulk and prevent employees from removing them
配置密码复杂度、锁屏时长和存储加密要求 / Configure password complexity, screen lock timeout, and storage encryption requirements
禁用相机、USB、蓝牙共享等高风险硬件能力 / Disable high-risk hardware features such as camera, USB, and Bluetooth sharing
统一管控 Wi‑Fi、VPN、代理和系统网络配置 / Centrally manage Wi‑Fi, VPN, proxy, and system network settings
限制应用白名单黑名单并控制应用运行权限 / Enforce app allowlists or blocklists and control app runtime permissions
接入企业设备注册激活流程并绑定组织信息 / Integrate enterprise device enrollment and activation with organization binding
实现 COPE 或 BYOD 场景下的工作资料隔离管理 / Implement work data separation management for COPE or BYOD scenarios
管理多家 EMM 共管时的管理员角色激活与冲突处理 / Handle admin role activation and policy conflicts in multi-EMM co-management
下发系统设置策略如亮度、状态栏、开发者选项限制 / Push system setting policies such as brightness, status bar, and developer options restrictions
do_not_use_when: 需求是接入游戏联合登录、实名认证、防沉迷、场景感知优化或近场快传，应改用 game-service-kit / The task is to integrate game sign-in, real-name verification, anti-addiction, game scene awareness optimization, or nearby fast transfer; use game-service-kit instead

需求是提升高帧率渲染、图形密集型负载表现、资源下载提速或启动加速，应改用 graphics-accelerate-kit / The goal is high-frame-rate rendering, better graphics-heavy workload performance, faster asset delivery, or startup acceleration; use graphics-accelerate-kit instead
需求是编写ArkTS单元测试、UI自动化测试、断言脚本或性能测试采集，应改用 test-kit / The requirement is to write ArkTS unit tests, UI automation tests, assertion scripts, or performance test collection; use test-kit instead
preconditions: 工程为Stage模型，目标SDK版本为5.0.0(API 12)及以上，且部署目标支持HarmonyOS NEXT / The project uses the Stage model, targets SDK 5.0.0 (API 12) or later, and deploys to a HarmonyOS NEXT device
应用已创建并配置EnterpriseAdminExtensionAbility组件，作为MDM管理能力入口 / The app has created and configured an EnterpriseAdminExtensionAbility component as the entry point for MDM management capabilities
应用已完成MDM所需资质申请、ACL授权及module.json5中的相关权限声明 / The app has completed required MDM qualification application, ACL authorization, and relevant permission declarations in module.json5
目标管理员组件已在设备上完成激活，且具备相应管理员角色权限 / The target admin component has been activated on the device and has the required administrator role permissions
inputs: 企业管理员组件信息 / enterprise admin component information
设备管理策略参数 / device management policy parameters
目标应用包名或应用标识 / target app bundle name or application identifier
目标设备设置项或硬件能力标识 / target device setting item or hardware capability identifier
outputs: 管理员激活状态与管理员角色信息（SDA/DA/BDA） / Admin activation status and admin role information (SDA/DA/BDA)
EnterpriseAdminExtensionAbility生命周期与管理事件回调（如onAdminEnabled、onAdminDisabled） / EnterpriseAdminExtensionAbility lifecycle and management event callbacks (such as onAdminEnabled, onAdminDisabled)
设备策略配置结果与可查询的策略值 / Device policy configuration results and queryable policy values
应用管理执行结果与应用管控状态（安装、卸载、禁用、允许/禁止列表） / Application management execution results and app control state (install, uninstall, disable, allow/deny lists)
安全策略对象与状态（密码策略、设备加密状态等） / Security policy objects and status (password policy, device encryption status, etc.)
远程设备控制执行结果（锁屏、恢复出厂设置等） / Remote device control execution results (lock screen, factory reset, etc.)
设备设置策略值（Wi-Fi、蓝牙、屏幕亮度、息屏时间等） / Device settings policy values (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, screen brightness, screen-off time, etc.)
硬件外设管控状态（USB、相机等启用/禁用状态） / Hardware peripheral control state (USB, camera, etc. enabled/disabled state)
网络通信管理策略与网络配置状态（网络访问限制、Wi-Fi配置等） / Network communication management policies and network configuration state (network access restrictions, Wi-Fi configuration, etc.)
设备与系统管理查询信息（设备标识、系统版本、合规/策略状态等） / Device and system management query information (device identifiers, system version, compliance/policy status, etc.)

postconditions.statement: 工程中已新增或修改EnterpriseAdminExtensionAbility相关实现与配置 / The project contains added or modified EnterpriseAdminExtensionAbility implementation and configuration
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set clearly add or modify an EnterpriseAdminExtensionAbility class or its registration/configuration for MDM administration?

postconditions.statement: 代码已调用MDM Kit相关企业设备管理API以实施设备、应用、安全或设置策略 / The code invokes MDM Kit enterprise device management APIs to enforce device, app, security, or settings policies
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, is there clear usage of enterprise device management APIs from MDM Kit to apply or manage policies?

postconditions.statement: 工程中体现了管理员激活、权限声明或ACL授权等MDM前置接入要求 / The project reflects MDM onboarding requirements such as admin activation, permission declarations, or ACL authorization
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits show concrete handling or configuration for MDM prerequisites such as admin activation flow, permission declarations, or ACL-related setup?
